{{Quote|This party is full of very self-important people. Their host's name is Rauk Oenish.|[[Anetia Kah'ryn]], to an entertainer|<ref name="SWG:TEL" />}}
'''Rauk Oenish''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Talk to him if you wish. He won't need you very long and you should get all the information you need within about 10 minutes.|[[Anetia Kah'ryn]], to an entertainer|<ref name="SWG:TEL" />}}
Rauk Oenish was a wealthy and powerful man who resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He also had connections with the criminal underworld.<ref name="SWG:TEL" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> some of his associates got involved in a plot organized by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. The plan was to incite the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] to attack [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] in order to pressurize the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] and eventually take control of the city.<ref name="SWG:TEL" />

During this time, a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[entertainer]] by the name [[Anetia Kah'ryn]] got very concerned about criminal and Tusken activity around Mos Eisley. Being a client of Rauk Oenish, Kah'ryn knew a lot about the criminals and very important people frequenting Oenish. She therefore tasked novice entertainers to go to a party organized by Rauk Oenish in Mos Eisley in order to get information. The entertainers joined the party and performed with talent but without attracting attention on them. They thus managed to overhear some secret discussions and obtained details about Jabba's plot. Anetia Kah'ryn was finally able to discover the truth and expose the whole conspiracy to Mayor [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]].<ref name="SWG:TEL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNobleMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Rauk Oenish.]]
Rauk Oenish was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TEL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rauk Oenish was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of a quest given by Anetia Kah'ryn to beginner players who had chosen a career of "[[W:c:swg:Entertainer (pre-NGE)|entertainer]]."<ref name="SWG:TEL" /> During each server reset, his appearance and [[Species/Legends|species]] were randomized, but he consistently appeared as a male.<ref name="SWG:TEL" />
